name: Courtyard farm (cour fermee)
description: Norman courtyard farm, about 27 x 23 m: a two-storey stone farmhouse with an attic, dressed quoins and a slate roof across the back, a stone stable-and-byre wing and a cider-press barn wing either side of a cobbled yard, a front wall with a slate-capped carriage arch and a pedestrian door closing it, a roofed well, a mounting block and a dung heap in the yard. Every range is enterable: kitchen, salle and dairy below, three bedrooms and an attic above; the stable and byre; the press barn and its store.
